name: weekday_successor
description: Day-of-week arithmetic: which weekday is k days after a given weekday. Control: letter-of-alphabet successor in the same frame.
generator_code:
import random, json, string
random.seed(0)
D=['Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday','Sunday']
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
    j=random.randrange(7);k=random.choice([1,1,2,3])
    ks={1:'one day',2:'two days',3:'three days'}[k]
    t=random.choice(["Q: What day comes {k} after {m}?\nA: The answer is","If today is {m}, then {k} from now it will be"])
    items.append({"prompt":t.format(k=ks,m=D[j]),"answer":" "+D[(j+k)%7]})
L=string.ascii_uppercase
for i in range(120):
    j=random.randrange(20);k=random.choice([1,1,2,3])
    ks={1:'one letter',2:'two letters',3:'three letters'}[k]
    t=random.choice(["Q: What letter comes {k} after {m}?\nA: The answer is","If the sign shows the letter {m}, then {k} later in the alphabet it will show"])
    control.append({"prompt":t.format(k=ks,m=L[j]),"answer":" "+L[j+k]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
